facts.fact: The Judiciary of Uganda says its Electronic Court Case Management Information System (ECCMIS) had expanded to 31 court stations across five rollout clusters by July 2025, after going live on 1 March 2022.
The Judiciary's FY2024/25 performance report says ECCMIS was rolled out to 23 courts that year and is operational in 11.5 percent of courts.
The Judiciary says ECCMIS gave litigants 24-hour access to e-filing and that cases are filed and fees paid online, per the Permanent Secretary to the Judiciary.
The Judiciary describes a litigant at Jinja High Court checking updates on her case file on her phone through ECCMIS.
